item.title: Rallying Cry – October 27, 2026
item.description: An Italian farmer’s attic seeds grew into a biblical harvest, mice with Parkinson’s-like symptoms recovered unexpectedly, and Toronto re-elected progressive mayor Olivia Chow for a second term.
